finding: Reconciliation tolerance may mask real errors
fix_goal: Account reconciliation must not false-PASS due to over-wide tolerance
tolerance_policy: Explicit tolerance per field type: price=0.01, quantity=0, amount=0.01, equity=1.0
strict_mode: Any amount difference > tolerance → ERROR. No silent swallowing.
warning_mode: Difference <= tolerance → PASS with recorded difference_abs/difference_pct in report
known_mismatch_fixture: Fixture with known price mismatch(1000 vs 1001) → MUST return FAILED, not PASS
acceptance_criteria: Amount difference <= tolerance → PASS but record difference
Tolerance must NOT default to infinite
Reconciliation report must output difference_abs, difference_pct, tolerance_used
Known mismatch fixture triggers FAILED not PASS

fix_goal: Rolling replay must FAIL_CLOSED when calendar is missing or malformed
missing_calendar_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED — return error dict with status=FAILED, error_type=CALENDAR_MISSING
malformed_calendar_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED — return error dict with status=FAILED, error_type=CALENDAR_MALFORMED
valid_calendar_behavior: Normal rolling slices with calendar-based date stepping
audit_message: Calendar dependency must be logged in replay audit trail
acceptance_criteria: Valid calendar → normal rolling slices produced
No silent empty result on calendar failure
